info: DBW Ventures GmbH is a newly established acquisition vehicle formed by three entrepreneurial investors for the purpose of acquiring Sporttherapie-Gesellschaft m.b.H. The investor team combines many years of experience in growth investing, transaction advisory and finance with hands-on operational expertise in corporate controlling.

Sporttherapie-Gesellschaft m.b.H. is a leading, licensed private outpatient clinic for physical therapy, specialising in rehabilitation and preventative care in Linz and Wels, Austria. A pioneer of private, physician-led care outside the statutory health insurance system, it offers an interdisciplinary therapy and training portfolio that has been established for over three decades, billed entirely on a self-pay basis and characterised by a clear marketing positioning and high patient loyalty.

The transaction ensures the long-term development of Sporttherapie under a dedicated owner, while enabling DBW Ventures to build on an established private outpatient rehabilitation provider with a strong brand and loyal patient base in Austria.
Translink Corporate Finance Austria acted as the exclusive advisor to the shareholders of Sporttherapie-Gesellschaft m.b.H. on its sale to DBW Ventures GmbH.
Erhvervsinvest is a Denmark-based private equity firm that invests through buyout investments in diversified small to medium-sized companies.
Kirstine Hardam is a distributor of medical products to retailers and patients.

Through this acquisition, Erhvervsinvest strengthens its selection of healthcare services providers, building on Kirstine Hardam’s strong position in Denmark and portfolio of high-quality products supporting patients in post-surgical aftercare.
Translink Corporate Finance acted as financial advisor to Kirstine Hardam on its sale to Erhvervsinvest.
WVT Group is a leading manufacturer of tailor-made cleaning chemicals for industrial and private label customers.
ÈCOSÌ is an Italian provider of professional detergents and cleaning systems.
The acquisition of ÈCOSÌ marks WVT Group’s official entry into the Italian market and is part of the Group’s strategy to build a leading European platform in sustainable hygiene solutions.
Translink Corporate Finance advised WVT Group on its acquisition of ÈCOSÌ.

Founded in 1985 and based in Charente-Maritime in France, the Sotrinbois-GTSWood Group specialises in the manufacture, processing and distribution of finishing and decorative products. As industry leaders, they have continuously expanded their product ranges, developed their sourcing of raw materials, and strengthened their industrial capabilities and logistics in order to meet customer expectations.
This transaction has successfully reorganised shareholding among existing shareholders to create a majority stake in the Group.
Translink Corporate Finance advised Lecaro on its joint venture with PGS Group.
Viking Growth is a Nordic growth investor specialising in B2B software companies.
OciusX is a developer of software for project management in fibre deployment and other infrastructure construction.
With Viking Growth as partner, OciusX can continue developing its product and build a stronger organisation in the United States.
Translink Corporate Finance advised OciusX on its new partnership with Viking Growth.
Skihut is a leading Dutch luxury ski wear, fashion, and swimwear specialist.
Carl Denig is one of the oldest specialised outdoor retailers in the Netherlands, with a history dating back to 1912.
The transaction combines two established outdoor and winter sports retailers, strengthening their market position and geographic footprint.
Translink Corporate Finance acted as financial advisor to Carl Denig on its sale to Skihut.
Keries B.V. is a group of trading and distribution companies, including SiebenEndstra, Carlogic and DRL Products.
Schiefer Lighting is an importer and wholesaler of light sources.

The acquisition of Schiefer Lighting expands Keries B.V.’s product offering with a broad range of light sources. Schiefer Lighting’s own brand and sourcing network in China add a new product category and an Asian sourcing platform to the group.
Translink Corporate Finance advised Keries B.V. on is acquisition of Schiefer Lighting.
PGS Group is a European leader in wooden pallet manufacturing, reconditioning, and pallet lifecycle management.
Lecaro is a specialist in the supply of new and used pallets.
The partnership strengthens PGS Group’s presence in the Netherlands and, at the same time, gives Lecaro new opportunities to support its continued growth.
Translink Corporate Finance advised Lecaro on its joint venture with PGS Group.

RadarGroep is an advisory and training group, comprising RadarAdvies, RadarVertige, RadarEurope and RadarSelect, that partners with governments and public sector professionals across Europe to build an inclusive and responsive society through consultancy, strategy, network governance and innovative learning solutions.

Regioplan is an Amsterdam-based policy research and advisory firm that partners with government, municipalities and other public and social organisations to create social impact across a range of public domains, from labour and social security to education, youth, care, safety and integration.
RadarGroep strengthens its position as a partner for social impact with leading policy research firm Regioplan.
Translink Corporate Finance advised Regioplan on its sale to RadarGroep.
Ilkka Oyj is one of Northern Europe’s leading marketing and technology companies.
Custobar is the leading customer data platform (CDP) and marketing automation solution for omnichannel retail in Finland.

Ilkka Oyj strengthens its position as one of the leading marketing and technology companies in Northern Europe. Custobar will continue under its own brand as part of Ilkka's Data and Technology business area.
Translink Corporate Finance advised Custobar on its sale to Ilkka Oyj.
Sertion is a Nordic group specialising in pipe installations, founded in 2024.
GA Rustfri is a well-established Danish specialist in industrial process solutions, serving customers in the food, pharmaceutical and process industries.
Through the acquisition, GA Rustfri will strengthen Sertion's capabilities within industrial infrastructure and broaden the Group's offering in technically advanced environments.
Translink Corporate Finance advised Sertion on its acquisition of GA Rustfri.
Sertion is a Nordic group specialising in pipe installations, founded in 2024.
Aqua & Care is a well-established Norwegian specialist in the service, maintenance and upgrading of UV water disinfection systems.

Sertion continues its expansive growth journey through the acquisition of Aqua & Care. The acquisition strengthens Sertion’s position within critical water infrastructure and takes the Group a step further in its development as a leading international infra- and installation partner.
Translink Corporate Finance advised Sertion on its acquisition of Aqua & Care.
Sertion is a Nordic group specialising in pipe installations, founded in 2024.
NTI is a well-established Norwegian technical contractor with more than 170 employees and extensive expertise across the entire project lifecycle.

Sertion continues its expansive growth journey through the acquisition of NTI. The acquisition strengthens Sertion’s position in technical infrastructure in Norway and enables it to take another step forward in its development as a leading international infra- and installation partner.
Translink Corporate Finance advised Sertion on its acquisition of NTI.

Marex Group Limited (NASDAQ: MRX) provides global access to financial and commodity markets, infrastructure services and essential liquidity to its clients. The company offers a broad range of services across four core business areas: Clearing, Agency & Execution, Market Making & Hedging, and Investment Solutions.
WEBB Traders has offices in Amsterdam and Paris and specialises in market making of single stock options on European and U.S. mid- and large-cap equities.

The acquisition will further enhance Marex Group Limited’s established Equity Linked Structured Products platform, allowing the Group to internalise hedging, enhance profit margins and provide better pricing for clients.
Translink Corporate Finance advised WEBB Traders on its sale to Marex Group Limited.

Sanviva is a European medical device distribution group operating across the Nordics and Benelux, with a portfolio covering wound care, ostomy care, in vitro diagnostics and adjacent specialist medical device categories. The group consists of Apodan, PartnerMed, AllweCare and XboXLab, and is backed by Axcel.

DermaCura is a Dutch specialist in therapeutic dressings for patients with chronic skin conditions. Founded over 40 years ago as a family business, the company has built a trusted position in specialised allergy and dermatology care in the Netherlands, offering CE-marked Class I medical devices that support the stepped-care treatment of atopic eczema.

Through the acquisition of DermaCura, Sanviva expands its Benelux presence and adds an adjacent dermatology segment to its existing portfolio of wound care, ostomy care and in vitro diagnostics. The transaction builds on Sanviva's established Dutch and Belgian sales creating a clear opportunity to support DermaCura's continued growth in the Netherlands and to explore selected international expansion over time.
Translink Corporate Finance advised DermaCura on its sale to Sanviva.

Romijnders is a full-service installation company based in Wijchen, the Netherlands. The company serves both residential and commercial customers, including retailers, housing associations, and utility and commercial buildings.

Installatiebureau Rutgers B.V. is a well-established technical installation company based in Oosterblokker, the Netherlands. Founded in 1924, the company has grown into a mid-sized installation services provider with approximately 40 employees.
Romijnders acquired Installatiebureau Rutgers as part of its growth strategy.
Translink Corporate Finance advised Installatiebureau Rutgers on its sale to Romijnders.

Clinique de Verdaich is an independent healthcare facility offering rehabilitation and readaptation for patients, placing emphasis on continuous innovation in approach and equipment, ongoing training, as well as research and development within the topic of disability support.

Clinique La Pinède is an independent post-acute and rehabilitation care facility, classifying highly in its quality of care to patients. The clinic is committed to a process of continuous improvement of the quality and safety of care and continually evaluate their professional practices.
Clinique de Verdaich, and a pool of regional healthcare institutions, acquired this asset to strengthen their medical footprint in the Occitanie region.
Translink Corporate Finance France advised Clinique La Pinède in its sale of 51% of capital to Clinique de Verdaich and local professional investors.
Information on Foqus Invest, Mathieu Mooren, René de Boer and HELIX Groep employees

A consortium of new shareholders, comprising investment company Foqus Invest, private investors Mathieu Mooren and René de Boer (founders of data science firm Digital Power), and HELIX Groep employees.
HELIX Groep is a newly formed healthcare group combining consultancy, interim staffing, and AI-driven solutions for healthcare providers.
The sale of minority stakes in newly formed HELIX Groep will enable the group to further professionalise and expand with new companies that share the same mission and passion for healthcare.
Translink Corporate Finance advised HELIX Groep on the sale of minority stakes to a consortium of investors.

Sophora Unternehmerkapital is an independent equity investment firm with a focus on medium-sized companies in Germany, Austria and Switzerland. Sophora's interdisciplinary team combines many years of investment experience with extensive operational expertise gained as entrepreneurs, founders and CEOs of companies.

SQUER is a Vienna-based specialist in software modernisation, digital transformation and applied AI, serving clients in highly regulated industries such as banking, insurance and the public sector. With over 100 specialists in Vienna (HQ) and Munich, the firm pairs deep technical know-how with long-standing client relationships across mission-critical software modernisation, cloud and platform engineering, and applied data & AI.

The strategic partnership between Sophora Unternehmerkapital and SQUER lays the foundation for building a leading digital transformation platform across the DACH region, driven by organic growth and targeted add-on acquisitions. SQUER’s founders remain significantly invested and will continue to lead the business.
Translink Corporate Finance advised SQUER on its partnership with Sophora Unternehmerkapital.

Sertion is a group of expert companies specialising in pipework and plumbing. Sertion’s focus within advanced pipework is design, installation, and service of water, heating, sanitation systems, industrial piping.

Megens is a well-established Dutch installation and service company with deep expertise in technical maintenance, building automation, measurement and control systems, and industrial piping solutions.

Sertion strengthens its position as a leading international infra and installation partner as Megens joins the Group in the Netherlands. The acquisition marks Sertion's entry into the Dutch market and represents an important step in the Group's continued international expansion.
Translink Corporate Finance advised Sertion, a portfolio company of Altor, in the acquisition of Megens.

Road Mobility Services is building an integrated network of strong local businesses in tyres, mobility and vehicle services across Northern Europe. The group serves transport companies, agricultural businesses and industrial customers.
Peet Borst Bandentechniek is an experienced tyre and vehicle service specialist offering a variety of services for all types of road vehicles, and agricultural and industrial machinery.

The acquisition strengthens Road Mobility Services' position in the Netherlands, one of Europe's most important logistics regions, aligning with its aspirations of building an integrated network of services. Peet Borst Bandentechniek brings three strategically located service centres with excellent long-standing customer relationships and a broad portfolio of services.
Translink Corporate Finance advised Peet Borst Bandentechniek on its sale to Road Mobility Services.

Visma is a leading provider of mission-critical cloud and AI software for SMBs. With its ecosystem of over 150 companies, the group has over than 17,000 employees and 2.5 million customers across Europe and Latin America. By simplifying and automating the work of businesses and organisations of all sizes, the company enables a more efficient and prosperous society.

Tek01 is an Italian SaaS company operating under the FatturaElettronica APP brand. It is one of the leading providers of e-invoicing and certified e-mail (PEC) products for freelancers, micro-businesses and SMBs. In 2025, the company had base of over 124,000 customers across the country and processed over 9.5 million invoices. In addition to its core e-invoicing solution, FatturaElettronica APP is launching an integrated payment service in 2026, enabling customers to receive and reconcile invoice payments directly within the platform.

Tek01 (FatturaElettronica APP) serves more than 124,000 freelancers, micro-businesses and SMBs, providing easy-to-use solutions that simplify e-invoicing and certified email compliance. In 2025, the company processed over 9.5 million invoices. In addition to its core solutions, it is launching an integrated payment service in 2026, enabling customers to receive and reconcile invoice payments directly within the platform. This will be complemented by a proprietary AI Accountant Assistant, further strengthening Visma's leadership in AI-powered business software.
Translink Corporate Finance advised Visma in its acquisition of Tek01 (FatturaElettronica APP).
MBO+ is a private equity fund.
Diferbat is the French leader in B2B distribution of door automation and access control solutions.
The transaction consists of a capital reorganisation. MBO+ invested in Diferbat to finance territorial coverage development and the external growth strategy.
Translink Corporate Finance acted as advisor to Diferbat on its sale to MBO+.
Skoyen Software is a long-term investor in business-critical B2B SaaS companies.
Bartec Municipal Technologies is a leading UK provider of integrated software, professional services and hardware for local authorities.
This transaction positions the business for its next phase of growth, providing it with additional investment and strategic support to accelerate innovation and expand its market presence.
Translink Corporate Finance advised Bartec Municipal Technologies on its sale to Skoyen Software.
Atout-Box is a French self-storage operator providing secure storage units for individuals and professionals.
Valibox is a premium self-storage facility with a high-quality real estate asset located in the Southeast of France.

The sale of Valibox enables Atout-Box to strengthen its presence in the south of France through a high-quality, well-located self-storage asset, while further accelerating its growth strategy in a consolidating French market.
Translink Corporate Finance advised Valibox on its sale to Atout-Box, selling 100% of Valibox’s share capital, together with the real estate assets used in its operations.

Founded in 2016, Tropic Biosciences is a leader in the development of cutting-edge and sustainable crop varieties. Tropic Biosciences is headquartered in Norwich, United Kingdom, with operations spanning Asia and Latin America, employing around 160 people globally.

Founded in 1974, Rahan Meristem is one of the world’s most established international banana propagation businesses. The company operates production facilities in Israel, Costa Rica, Colombia, Ecuador and the Philippines, employs more than 200 professionals and supplies growers across the major banana-producing regions.

The acquisition of Rahan provides Tropic with the propagation capacity, operational infrastructure and regional presence needed to accelerate commercial deployment worldwide. By combining Tropic’s gene-editing pipeline with Rahan’s large-scale propagation expertise and established grower relationships, Tropic is creating an integrated platform capable of developing, propagating and distributing improved banana varieties at commercial scale.
Translink Corporate Finance acted as advisor to Rahan Meristem on the sale of 100% of its shares to Tropic Biosciences.
Axcel is a private equity firm investing across Northern Europe, with a focus on four sectors: Technology, Business Services & Industrials, Healthcare and Consumer.
AllweCare is a company specialising in the import, distribution, and promotion of high-quality medical supplies and devices.

Backed by Nordic private equity firm Axcel, Sanviva has been established as a new European medical device distribution network, specialised in continence, ostomy and wound care, among others. The transaction comprised the simultaneous closing of four acquisitions across the Nordics and the Benelux, creating a strong platform for further European growth. As part of Sanviva, AllweCare joins a group spanning six countries and more than fifty suppliers, combining local market expertise with international collaboration.
Translink Corporate Finance Benelux is pleased to have acted as financial advisor to AllweCare Medical on its partnership with Axcel.
Aveso Oy operates as IT consultant and a partner for IFS ERP, data management and system integration solutions.

FLEXiCODE Gmbh, a portfolio company of EOS Capital, is a leading IFS implementation partner. Headquartered in Germany, FLEXiCODE company delivers IFS consulting, implementation and support services to customers across Europe, with a focus on asset-intensive industries.

By joining forces, FLEXiCODE and Aveso Oy establish together one of the largest pure-play IFS Cloud service providers in Europe, with more than EUR 25 million in combined revenues and around 150 specialists across the Nordics and DACH region.
Translink Corporate Finance teams in Finland and Germany acted as exclusive financial advisor to Aveso Oy, a Finnish IFS consulting firm, on its sale to FLEXiCODE, a portfolio company of EOS Capital.
XPartners is a leading provider of multidisciplinary engineering services for both public and private clients across the Nordics.
Costa Laskenta is one of Finland’s leading specialists in construction cost management and cost intelligence services.
By joining forces, Costa Laskenta and XPartners strengthen their presence in Finland and expand their quantity surveying and cost estimation expertise across the construction sector.
Translink Corporate Finance advised the shareholders of Costa Laskenta on its sale to XPartners Group.

The management buyout (MBO) was led by an experienced executive with longstanding ties to the Group, who previously served as Managing Director of Weidemann Gebäudemanagement, one of the company's divisions.

Weidemann-Gruppe is a leading provider of facility services for the healthcare sector. Through its subsidiaries Weidemann Gebäudemanagement, Weidemann Catering and Weidemann Consulting, the Group provides a broad range of non-medical services tailored to hospitals, rehabilitation clinics and care institutions, including cleaning, catering and facility management. A key differentiator of the Group is its expertise in the establishment and management of service companies for healthcare providers. This model enables customers to combine operational flexibility and efficiency with close operational control and has resulted in long-standing customer relationships and a strong market position within the German healthcare sector.

The transaction provides a long-term succession solution for Weidemann-Gruppe and ensures continuity for employees, customers and business partners. As part of the management buyout, ownership is transferred to an experienced executive with longstanding ties to the Group. Under its new entrepreneurial ownership, Weidemann-Gruppe is well positioned to continue its successful development and further strengthen its market position.
Translink Corporate Finance acted as advisor to the shareholders of Weidemann-Gruppe on a management buyout.
Nili Capital is a leading American-Israeli PE firm.
Information on Chic Hlavin Cosmetic Group

Chic Hlavin Cosmetic Group is a leading Israeli cosmetics manufacturer and brand owner specialising in research, development, manufacturing, sales and distribution of a wide range of cosmetic and dermo-cosmetic products.
Through the acquisition of 100% of Chic Hlavin Cosmetic Group, Nili Capital intends to use the company as a platform for further growth and acquisitions in the cosmetics and personal care sector.
Translink Corporate Finance acted as the exclusive advisor to Chic Hlavin Cosmetic Group on its sale to Nili Capital.

MILON Group is a European multi-family office (PE) with a long-term investment horizon. The firm focuses on mid-sized companies and corporate carve-outs or spin-offs across Europe with significant operational value creation potential. Backed by investors with a strong entrepreneurial background, MILON Group actively supports the development and growth of its portfolio companies.

Headquartered in Madrid, Mediapost Spain is a promotional marketing company providing end-to-end solutions to brands, retailers and service companies. The company looks back to more than 25 years of experience in marketing services. With over 150 people, the company operates two complementary business units: Directia, a third-party logistics operator specialised in promotional, conventional and e-commerce logistics, and Galanta, a specialist in B2B incentives, loyalty and promotional solutions.

MILON Group sees Muviria as a solid platform with significant operational expertise and a clear opportunity to further develop its value proposition in promotional marketing, logistics, incentives and sales activation,
Translink Corporate Finance advised Mediapost Spain on its sale to MILON Group.
VækstPartner Kapital is small Danish private equity fund.
Gruber is a manufacturer of machines for the pharmaceutical industry.

VækstPartner Kapital and Gruber have a shared aim to further drive growth and develop Gruber's unique areas of strength. The new owners will assist management to accelerate the expansion of the company.
Translink Corporate Finance acted as advisor to Gruber on its sale to VækstPartner Kapital.
WVT Group is a leading manufacturer of tailor-made cleaning chemicals for industrial and private label customers.
CYGYC BIOCON develops, manufactures, and markets chemical specialties and biotechnological solutions.

This acquisition brings complementary expertise in enzyme technology and in-house R&D to WVT Group, expanding the group's product development capabilities across its core verticals. Beyond technology and market reach, CYGYC BIOCON's balanced portfolio across chemicals, enzymes, and probiotics strengthens WVT Group's ability to offer comprehensive, sustainable hygiene solutions to its customers. The combined group’s turnover will reach more than €100 million.
Translink Corporate Finance advised WVT Group on its acquisition of CYGYC BIOCON.
Information on Leading Brokers United Spain (GGW Group)
Leading Brokers United Spain is an insurance broker company, part of the GGW Group, a leading European insurance brokerage platform for small and medium-sized enterprises.
Information on Grup Vila Corredoria d’Assegurances (Covergrup)
Grup Vila Corredoria d’Assegurances (Covergrup) is an insurance broker, with a unique combination of expertise in community-based insurance, brand strength and digital excellence.

By joining Leading Brokers United Spain, Covergrup will bring a highly attractive segment to a growing market. This integration opens up significant opportunities for cross-selling products and services, as well as considerable potential for technological collaboration and process optimisation within the group.
Translink Corporate Finance advised Leading Brokers United Spain (GGW Group) on its integration of Grup Vila Corredoria d’Assegurances (Covergrup).

BGIS is a global leader in integrated facility management services. Offering a full range of facility and real estate management services, BGIS partners with clients globally to deliver innovative solutions. BGIS is a technology enabled, technically led global integrated facilities management provider focused on delivering disruptive business solutions for its clients, through a culture of caring, innovation and high-performance. With a rich engineering background, a commitment to sustainability and service excellence, BGIS ensures its clients’ real estate assets are operating optimally to support the people who use them.
Information on Ascot Air Facilities Pty Ltd
Ascot Air Facilities Pty Ltd is a leading provider of commercial air conditioning and mechanical services, including design, installation and maintenance in SouthEast Queensland.
The transaction strengthens BGIS' mechanical capabilities and aligns with its existing integrated technical trades services offering in Queensland.
Translink Corporate Finance acted as the advisor to Ascot Air Facilities Pty Ltd on the sale of their business to BGIS.
Dunapack Packaging, part of the Prinzhorn Group is a manufacturing company that designs and produces high-quality customised and printed corrugated packaging.

Stora Enso is a leading provider of renewable products in packaging, biomaterials and wooden construction, and one of the largest private forest owners in the world. Gaster Wellpappe, Sausenheimer Wellpappe and PTI together form its integrated corrugated packaging business.

The transaction marks a further important step in the growth strategy of Dunapack Packaging aiming to increase its geographical footprint and will additionally foster the paper integration rate within the group.
Translink CF advised Stora Enso on the sale of Gaster Wellpappe, Sausenheimer Wellpappe and PTI to Dunapack Packaging.
Consolid Equity is a Swedish private equity firm that invests in B2B service companies in the Nordics and Northern Europe.
UW-Tech is a leading player in diving and underwater operations in Sweden.
Consolid Equity saw potential in combining UW-Tech's unique technical expertise with other capabilities in critical infrastructure subsea operations.
Translink Corporate Finance advised UW-Tech on its sale to Consolid Equity.
YES Brands is a financial and strategic business partner to businesses that inspire youth.
Indigo Gymnastics Center is a provider of training and competitive opportunities in gymnastics for young athletes.

Sertion continues its expansive growth journey through the acquisition of Aqua & Care. The acquisition strengthens Sertion’s position within critical water infrastructure and takes the Group a step further in its development as a leading international infra- and installation partner.
Translink Corporate Finance's US Partner, Dinan & Company, initiated the acquisition of Indigo Gymnastics Center by YES Brands.
Wadinko is a Dutch investment company, which aims to promote a strong business climate and employment in the eastern and northeastern regions of the Netherlands.
Beaphar is a family-owned company, founded in 1942, which specialises in the production of high-quality pharmaceuticals, care products, and nutrition for a wide range of animal species.
Through this investment, Wadinko supports the family-owned company in its transformation process as part of an international growth strategy.
Translink Corporate Finance advised Beaphar on its investment from Wadinko
Sertion is a group of expert companies specialising in pipework and plumbing.
Skanda is a Danish specialised engineering and contracting partner within the energy and industrial sectors.
Through the acquisition of Skanda in Denmark, Sertion surpasses 3 billion SEK in revenue.
Translink Corporate Finance advised Sertion, a portfolio company of Consolid Equity, on the acquisition of Skanda A/S

Visma is a leading provider of mission-critical cloud software, with revenue of € 3.6 billion in 2025, more than 17,000 employees and 2.0 million customers across Europe and Latin America. fulll is a leading French provider of accounting and payroll software solutions for accounting offices and professional service firms.

This partnership strengthens Visma's strategy to deliver comprehensive accounting, tax and payroll software solutions in France, equipping businesses with mission-critical tools that ensure compliance, enhance automation and operational efficiency.
Translink Corporate Finance acted as advisor to Visma in its acquisition of a minority stake in fulll.

With more than 40 years of history, Ofoten Rør has established itself as a leading HVAC contractor in Narvik, Norway.
Through the acquisition of Ofoten Rør, Sertion continues its growth journey, with the ambition of becoming a leading group in its business areas across the Nordics and Northern Europe.
Translink Corporate Finance advised Sertion, a portfolio company of Consolid Equity, on the acquisition of Ofoten Rør
Waypoint Acquisitions is an investment group focused on majority investments in family-owned and founder-led businesses.
Stillwater Hospice is a provider of comprehensive hospice services in Montana, Wyoming, and South Dakota.
Translink Corporate Finance’s US partner, Dinan & Company, initiated the acquisition of Stillwater Hospice by Waypoint Acquisitions.
Sertion is a group of expert companies specialising in pipework and plumbing.

Founded in 1965, Bryne Rør has extensive experience in installation, project delivery and service within HVAC and technical piping systems. Since its inception, the company has built a strong business with a clear focus on quality, customer relationships and technical expertise. The company is well established in Norway and holds a strong market position in the Jæren region.

Through the acquisition, Sertion continues its ambitious growth journey of becoming a leading group within the complex HVAC, technical infrastructure and industrial piping sector across the Nordics and Northern Europe.
Translink Corporate Finance advised Sertion, a portfolio company of Consolid Equity, on the acquisition of Bryne Rør AS.

Revivo Group AB is a Sweden-based industrial group focused on surface treatment services, including blasting, industrial coating, and fire protection for critical infrastructure, industrial facilities, buildings, and the maritime sector. The company is a portfolio company of Helix Kapital and serves as a platform for consolidating surface treatment businesses across the Nordic region.

Solidenergy is a leading provider of surface treatment services, with more than 50 years of history in the Norwegian market. The company operates within the energy, offshore and infrastructure sectors and is headquartered in Agotnes outside Bergen, employing approximately 600 people.

The acquisition establishes Revivo Group in the Norwegian market and creates a platform for continued expansion in offering protective coatings and surface services for critical infrastructure. The Norwegian market is characterised by strong activity within energy, offshore, and infrastructure, sectors that are exposed to technically demanding and harsh environments.
Translink Corporate Finance advised Revivo Group AB, a portfolio company of Helix Kapital, on the acquisition of Solidenergy AS.
Steyr Motors AG is one of the world’s leading companies in the field of customised engines for mission-critical defence and civilian applications.
Founded in 1899 and headquartered in Krusaa, Denmark, BUKH A/S is a leading international specialist in SOLAS-certified engines for rescue and military boats.

Steyrs Motors AG acquires 100% of BUKH A/S in a combined cash and new shares transaction. The acquisition marks a strategic step for Steyr Motors in becoming a broadly positioned, globally scalable supplier in the field of mission-critical marine applications.
Translink Corporate Finance advised BUKH A/S on the sale to Steyr Motors AG.
Leap Partners is a leading HVAC and plumbing buyer.
Prow Brothers, Inc. is a provider of heating repair, HVAC, plumbing and electrical services.
Olyos is a leading French Pharmaceutical group, specialising in natural health and nutrition products.
Founded in 1973, Somatoline is a historic leading Italian brand specialising in OTC products, cosmetics and health supplements in the pharmacy dermo-cosmetics segment.
With strong know-how in the pharmaceutical sector and a worldwide presence, Olyos will support Somatoline to build an important international platform and cultivate strong growth prospects.
Translink Corporate Finance advised Manetti & Roberts, a company controlled by Bolton Group, in the sale of the Somatoline brand to Olyos Group.
UCS Group has been a leading provider in the electrical infrastructure space for over 25 years.
Information on GPE Electrical and Communications Contractor Pty Ltd
GPE Electrical and Communications Contractor Pty Ltd is a provider of electrical services across multiple sectors throughout Southern NSW and Northern Victoria.
The acquisition of GPE aligns with UCS Group's regional diversification strategy and will support expansion of operational capability and service coverage.
Translink CF advised GPE Electrical and Communications Contractor Pty Ltd on the sale of their business to UCS Group.
Evallic is home to leading European defence technology companies, dedicated to protecting society through advanced, mission-critical solutions.
Information on Wireless P2P Technologies AB

With more than a decade of experience in academic research and R&D, Wireless P2P Technologies delivers secure tactical communications, software-defined radio systems, and electronic warfare solutions to defence customers across ground, maritime, and aerial domains — including both troop and unmanned platforms.

Through the acquisition, Wireless P2P Technologies gains access to Evallic's platform, industrial capabilities, and global defence market reach, while Evallic expands its capabilities into next-generation tactical communications, anti-jam datalinks, and autonomous system connectivity.
Translink Corporate Finance advised Wireless P2P Technologies, on its partnership and sale to Evallic, a portfolio company of Adelis Equity.
Standout Capital is a Stockholm-based private equity firm investing in Nordic tech companies.
Smartsign is a Swedish software company within digital signage. The company develops and delivers a market-leading platform for the management and publishing of digital screen content.

Standout Capital will become the majority shareholder in the company. The partnership creates strong conditions to accelerate Smartsign’s continued growth and strengthen the company’s position in the international market.
Translink Corporate Finance acted as the advisor to Smartsign in the sale to Standout Capital.
Information on Impact Bridge Asset Management

Impact Bridge Asset Management is a Spanish impact investment manager focused on sustainability and the transition towards more efficient and responsible production models. The firm invests in companies whose technologies contribute to measurable environmental and social impact, with particular emphasis on resource efficiency and the sustainable transformation of the agri-food sector.

IKOS Advanced is a Spanish agri-technology company specialising in digital solutions for precision agriculture. The company develops integrated systems that combine sensors, IoT devices and data analytics to optimise irrigation management and support data-driven agronomic decision-making. Through its proprietary technology platform, IKOS collects and processes real-time data on soil, climate and crop conditions, enabling farmers to automate irrigation processes, improve farm management and reduce water and resource consumption.

The transaction brings a specialised impact investor with a strong focus on sustainability and resource efficiency into the company’s shareholder base.
